name: Aircall
summary: Cloud phone system for sales and support teams: call routing, analytics and CRM integrations.
best_for: sales and support teams (3+ seats) that want a polished cloud phone system embedded in their CRM/helpdesk, with call routing, analytics and 250+ integrations
skip_if: you're a solo operator or duo (the 3-license minimum prices you out), or you need a full contact-center suite with omnichannel routing
honest_knock: Two structural catches: the 3-seat minimum makes the real starting price triple the sticker, and the annual-vs-monthly gap is steep (Professional: $50 vs $70). 'Unlimited calling' covers listed regions — check yours — and AI features increasingly live in add-ons or higher tiers. It's polished and integration-rich; just price the seats you'll actually have, on the billing cycle you'll actually choose.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Essentials, per licence · per licence per month on annual billing ($40 billed monthly), minimum 3 licences
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-10 on aircall.io/pricing in a live browser, with Aircall's own country selector on United States) Essentials is $30 per license a month and Professional $50, both on annual billing, which the page marks as 25% off monthly. Flip that toggle and the monthly rates read $40 and $70 per license. The discount is not uniform either: Essentials really is 25% off, but Professional lands closer to 29%, so price the plan you will actually buy rather than trusting the badge. The comparison table sets a minimum of 3 users on Essentials and Professional, so the smallest Essentials bill is $90 a month on annual billing. Enterprise is custom pricing from 25 users. Both paid plans now say they include AI Voice Agents: Essentials lists 50 min AI Voice Agents per month, and Professional is everything in Essentials plus AI call summary and conversation intelligence, smart routing, Power Dialer and outbound campaigns; on the US storefront both list unlimited calls within US & Canada. AI Voice Agents can also be bought on their own, without the phone system, at a $100 per month minimum on annual billing or $125 monthly. Minutes beyond the allowance cost $0.49 a minute pay-as-you-go, dropping to $0.39 above 2,500, or come in bundles: $175 for 500 minutes, $725 for 2,500 and $1,900 for 10,000, then about $0.19 a minute up to 35,000 ($6,650); at 54,000 minutes the calculator switches to custom pricing as low as $0.12 a minute. Add-ons, per seat a month: AI Assist Pro $49, WhatsApp $10 plus WhatsApp's own messaging rates, Analytics+ $15 and Aircall for Salesforce Voice $30. AI Messaging Agents are $0.15 to $0.35 per conversation and branded caller ID $0.08 per call, so the licence fee is a floor rather than the bill. The separate AI Assist add-on at $9 that we read on 27 September is no longer in the add-on list; the comparison table now marks call summaries, topics and call scoring as AI Assist on all three plans. The Netherlands storefront shows the same numerals in euros (EUR 30 and EUR 50), not an amount converted at the exchange rate.
